::: {.page-banner}
# Application Details
:::

::: grid


::: {.g-col-6 .text_block}
Building on two decades of experience, the 2026 Summer School offers a unique opportunity for PhD candidates and early-career academics in communication, sociology, psychology and political science:

- to attend an immersive, five-day program that comprises lectures, master classes, paper presentations, and mentoring sessions; and
- to build long-lasting personal and scholarly relations in a celebrated friendly and productive environment.

Participation in the ICA Political Communication Summer School will be on a competitive basis. Individuals interested in being considered will need to complete the application form, which requires standard information (e.g., name, email address, institutional affiliation, a description of research interests, and ongoing projects [max. 200 words]). In addition, applicants will need to upload a research proposal or extended abstract of a research paper related to political communication (max. three pages) and a copy of their CV. Applications also require a recommendation letter sent directly to cdp@leeds.ac.uk no later than March 25. Applications are considered complete only after the recommendation letter has been received.

An international selection committee will evaluate applications based on scholarly quality, fit with the Summer School, and cohort diversity.

### Key Information

-	The Summer School begins Monday at 9:00, and ends Friday at 17:30.
-	Enrollment fee: £550 (covers accommodation at Devonshire Hall beginning Sunday night, with checkout on Friday; all lunches and morning/midmorning refreshments).
-	Application deadline for participants: March 23 (23:59 GMT)
-	Application deadline for letters of recommendation: March 25 (23:59 GMT)
-	Notifications of application status: April 15


### Application Form

- Access the Application form [here](https://polcomm.github.io/summer-school/participation/application.html).
